findings.original_claim: Summary says sole-source actions require approved justification; Contracting Terms implies a J&A for all other-than-full-and-open contracts.
findings.required_change: Use: Sole-source means soliciting and negotiating with one source. Apply the justification, approval, or determination required by the specific authority and procedure; a FAR Part 6 J&A is not universal. The statutory-authority and public-interest exceptions and procedures excluded from Part 6 have their own rules. Cite FAR-Overhaul-Part6-2026 and DoD-RFO-Deviation-Part6-2026.
findings.explanation: Preserves coursebook definition without turning a common J&A workflow into a universal mandate.

findings.original_claim: Contracting Terms says bid must conform to all IFB requirements.
findings.required_change: Use: A sealed bid must conform in all material respects to the IFB; minor informalities are handled under the applicable sealed-bidding rules. Retain the existing detailed responsiveness explanation. Cite new FAR-14-301-Responsiveness (https://www.acquisition.gov/far/14.301).
findings.explanation: Existing later section correctly says material respects; harmonize the short definition to avoid implying any trivial defect automatically defeats responsiveness.

findings.original_claim: PM authority table lists Tenure agreement.
findings.required_change: Replace PM cell with CAE designation (tenure agreement documents assignment); retain existing note about 5000.66 and designation. Cite edo-3-2-1-intro-contracting-2025.
findings.explanation: The footnote, already retained in guide, identifies the actual designation authority more precisely than the table memory hook.

notes: All slides including decorative imagery, role table, overviews, and summaries visually inspected. No image-only substantive topic omitted. Existing SSA caveat and RFO crosswalk correctly improve coursebook shorthand.
Official current DoD deviation attachment verification limits in earlier audit remain; this module does not claim a newly retrieved full current DFARS attachment.
